# ThunderGits

> ThunderGits Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd is a Business Growth Partner based in Samastipur, Bihar, India. We combine strategy, web and mobile development, search visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO), digital marketing and AI solutions for startups, SMEs and enterprises across India, the USA, UK and UAE. Trusted by 50+ businesses with a team of 25+ specialists.

## Services

- [Consultancy & Strategy](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html): Market, audience and competitor research, growth roadmaps, IT consultancy, technology roadmaps, compliance and system integrations
- [Web Development](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#website-development): Custom responsive websites, CMS integration, web applications, React, Next.js
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#application-development): iOS and Android apps using React Native and Flutter
- [Search Visibility (SEO, GEO, AEO)](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html): SEO for Google rankings, GEO for visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity), AEO for featured snippets
- [Digital Marketing & Ads](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#digital-marketing): SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media marketing, content strategy, analytics
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html): User research, wireframing, prototyping, interface design
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html): Vulnerability assessments, threat monitoring, encryption, security integrations
- [Machine Learning & AI](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#machine-learning-ai): Predictive analytics, NLP, computer vision, AI automation
- [AI Consulting](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#ai-consulting): AI strategy, model development and deployment, automation roadmaps
- [Cloud Computing](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#cloud-computing): AWS, Azure and GCP migrations, cloud-native development, infrastructure management
- [DevOps & CloudOps](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#devops-cloudops): CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, cost optimization, Kubernetes
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#ecommerce-solutions): Online stores, payment gateways, inventory management, Shopify and WooCommerce
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#custom-software): CRMs, ERPs, SaaS platforms, bespoke enterprise systems
- [Business Intelligence](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html#business-intelligence): Dashboards, KPI tracking, big-data analytics, Power BI
- [Ongoing Partnership](https://www.thundergits.com/service.html): Dedicated monthly team that manages, maintains and grows your website, ads, social media and search visibility after launch

## Company Information

ThunderGits Consultancy Services Pvt Ltd is registered in India. We act as a long-term growth partner rather than a one-off vendor: one team owns strategy, technology, search visibility and marketing.

**Key facts:**
- 50+ businesses served
- 3+ years of experience
- 25+ team members
- Clients: Davabharti, Enersol, Thikana, Vaidik Sanskar, WeThePeopleOfPatna, Ganesha Foundation, AAP Bihar, Pasuseva, Coding Pandas
